title: Part Three: The Jews of Iran: Paradox or Two Facts?

sections.brief: The first fact: 2,700 years (biblical count) / 2,500 (Cyrus onward), Esther and Mordecai's tomb in Hamadan; population by census (1956, 2011, 2016) vs estimates, the 'over 20,000' figure tested; constitution Arts. 12-14, 64 (no mention of Zionism); MP Sameh; synagogues, schools; Khomeini's May 1979 assurance in its attested wordings; community statements in the 2025 and 2026 wars and the limits on free speech. Figures: time

The second fact: Elghanian (9 May 1979), emigration, constitutional and practical limits, the 1999-2000 Shiraz trial, Arvin Ghahremani (2024, contested), the 2006 Holocaust-denial conference and leaders' statements, the regime's anti-Zionist-not-anti-Jewish line and critics; why it matters for the war: Netanyahu's regime-vs-people framing, wartime questioning of Jews, the Rafi'-Nia synagogue strike (7 April 2026). Figures: compare (Recognition / Restriction); stats (population over time)
